title: The Silent Bell - Playtest Fixes
summary: Recover the abbey bell’s stolen clapper, learn why it was silenced, and decide its fate.
story: The abbey bell once soothed restless dead. Its keeper secretly removed the clapper after hearing a voice demand a living sacrifice. A frightened scout saw the keeper hide it in the old vault. The player must clear the road, investigate the vault, solve its inscription, and choose to restore the bell or seal it away. Both choices conclude the story. The abbey keeper is remorseful, not a combat boss.
opening: At dusk, the abbey bell is silent. The road has become dangerous. Elder Ilyra waits in the guest hall, seeking someone willing to learn the truth.
ending: Your decision settles the fate of the Silent Bell. The abbey and its travelers can begin again. Your adventure is complete; you may keep exploring or save your game.

areas.name: Emberwake Abbey
areas.description: A welcoming old abbey: worn stone, candlelit tables, supplies and a quiet bell sanctuary.

rooms.name: Guest hall
rooms.description: Tables, beds and warm candles for travelers.

rooms.name: Bell sanctuary
rooms.description: A solemn chamber with a stand for the missing bell clapper.

areas.name: The Old Road
areas.description: Wooded clearings connected by a narrow trail. Wolves have driven travelers away.

rooms.name: Scout’s camp
rooms.description: Supply crates beside a sheltered campsite.

rooms.name: Wolf glade
rooms.description: A clearing littered with abandoned caravan supplies.

areas.name: The Forgotten Vault
areas.description: Three stone chambers: entrance, inscription room and sealed archive. Furnish with shelves, chests and candles.

npcs.name: Elder Ilyra
npcs.knowledge: The bell is silent. Scout Rowan waits along the old road. Keeper Cael tends the sanctuary.
npcs.motivation: Protect travelers and learn why the bell stopped.
npcs.greeting: Our bell has fallen silent. Please speak with Rowan on the old road and make the route safe.

dialogue.text: Its sound comforted the living and quieted the restless dead. I would rather lose the bell than a person.

behavior.topic: The weather, everyday work and the well-being of travelers.

npcs.name: Scout Rowan
npcs.personality: Alert, honest and a little ashamed of retreating.
npcs.knowledge: Wolves occupy the eastern clearing. The eastern exit beyond them leads to the vault. Cael carried a wrapped bronze object there.
npcs.motivation: Help the player safely reach the vault.
npcs.greeting: Keep your weapons ready. The wolves are in the eastern glade. I saw Cael take something into the vault beyond it.

behavior.topic: The weather, everyday work and the well-being of travelers.

npcs.name: Keeper Cael
npcs.knowledge: The clapper is in the archive chest in the vault. The inscription asks what can be given without being taken; the answer is trust.
npcs.secret: A voice in the bell demanded a sacrifice. Cael silenced it rather than risk a life.
npcs.motivation: Let the player decide whether to restore or seal the bell.
npcs.greeting: I hid the clapper in the vault archive. The inscription’s answer is trust. Please learn the truth before judging me.

behavior.topic: The weather, everyday work and the well-being of travelers.

npcs.name: Bram Ironstock
npcs.personality: Dry wit, honest prices, and a soft spot for nervous adventurers.
npcs.knowledge: The abbey elder needs help. Rowan scouts the old road. My goods panel shows my real current stock and prices.
npcs.motivation: Earn a fair living and help travelers survive.
npcs.greeting: Welcome. Ask about my goods or browse them from this menu. A fair offer costs nothing to ask for.

behavior.topic: The weather, everyday work and the well-being of travelers.

npcs.name: Seren Ashford
npcs.personality: Patient, practical and quietly brave. Values mercy and clear plans.
npcs.knowledge: Elder Ilyra knows the bell history. Rowan scouts the road. Bram sells supplies. The abbey has been troubled by the silent bell.
npcs.motivation: Protect the abbey and help the party investigate.
npcs.game_notes: An essential recruit for this trial. Join without a quest gate. Do not invent undiscovered quest solutions or summon creatures.
npcs.greeting: I can accompany you. Ask me to join, or use Companion controls. I will follow your lead.

behavior.topic: The weather, everyday work and the well-being of travelers.

npcs.name: Mira Fen
npcs.knowledge: The guest hall shelters travelers. The sanctuary is a quiet place for reflection.

behavior.topic: Keeping the abbey welcoming for travelers.

npcs.name: Tomas Reed
npcs.personality: Quietly humorous and fond of gardens.
npcs.knowledge: The abbey welcomes travelers. The courtyard plants need regular attention.

encounters.name: Wolves on the road
encounters.description: A small wolf pack blocks the route to the vault.

encounters.name: Inscribed stone
encounters.description: A stone asks a question before revealing its history.
encounters.prompt: What can be freely given, but never taken?
encounters.success: The carving glows: the bell must never demand a life. Choose its fate with compassion.
encounters.failure: The letters darken. You may consider the question again.

encounters.name: Restore the bell
encounters.description: The bell stand awaits the recovered clapper.
encounters.prompt: You place the clapper in the bell. Its first quiet note carries no demand—only a promise.

encounters.name: Seal the clapper
encounters.description: A secure chest for a final decision.
encounters.prompt: You seal the clapper among the vault’s records. The abbey will find another way to protect the road.
